source.title: ProspectMate addon listing (research lead, not measured samples)

notes: Distinct follow-up angle: hunt for publicly shared ProspectMate Dragonflight character SavedVariables / per-cast ore or herb output logs, not already imported 2022–23 Reddit/Xenastro/Bugy/Aary cohorts. Six name-scoped searches across GitHub, Reddit, CurseForge, Blizzard forums and Wowhead yielded no previously unindexed source-original completed-cast/zero-inclusive histogram. An addon able to record prospects is not an empirical source without actual exported observations. All output quantities, per-material hit counts and completed operations remain unknown; no values promoted to measured. Do not revisit this negative search without a new raw-export lead.
lookingFor: Previously unindexed public ProspectMate raw exports or per-cast records for rank-specific Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic prospecting and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling, including zero outcomes and Resourcefulness.
